scope: All automated inline feedback, review-body additional comments, pre-merge checks and embedded tool diagnostics available at triage time. Duplicates are grouped with source identifiers.

items.subject: Workspace member sources omitted from Docker builder
items.rationale: Restored full context copy under .dockerignore, preserving arbitrary member/path dependency layouts.

validation.before: Docker source-stage build failed: failed to read /build/crates/fixture-cli/Cargo.toml (os error 2).
validation.after: Same nested workspace cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 succeeds.

items.subject: Fixture-only changes did not trigger Docker checks
items.rationale: Docker PR paths now include the Python fixture, Bash wrapper, and new negative regression script.

items.subject: Installed toolchains were overridden by rust-toolchain.toml
items.rationale: MSRV now invokes rustc/cargo with the explicit minimum version; the test matrix sets RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN and prints rustc version.

validation.before: Run 39636236287 MSRV, beta and nightly logs auto-installed 1.99.1 after their toolchain setup.

items.subject: Any failed untrusted run counted as CA rejection
items.rationale: Require the fixture server to observe TLSV1_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA. CLI connection errors omit the underlying certificate cause, so matching CLI stderr alone cannot verify this image.

validation.before: Injecting a DNS error into only the untrusted run still printed untrusted_ca_rejected: true.
validation.after: Same injection fails with Expected an untrusted-issuer TLS error; genuine runtime image still passes untrusted/trusted-CA login and clients checks. Regression runs in Docker CI.

items.subject: Original libstdc++ hash was architecture-ambiguous
items.rationale: Stored separate amd64 and arm64 hashes.

validation.observed: Re-exported libstdc++.so.6 from original immutable amd64 and arm64 images; SHA256 matches 972bb2a18b71140dab0240f8a1f68ab3fb1d56bcd4c4f824a91b70888faf5a00 and fff1f0050a33ddf29c44634c7639ac16e2573a61e3daab4fcc4c007b432ccf19, respectively.

items.subject: zlib alert reused libc resolver rationale
items.rationale: Updated JSON and Markdown alert 107 to the crc32_combine64/crc32_combine_gen64 CPU-consumption issue. Reachability remains unproven; removal remains the remediation.

items.subject: Missing spaces in security evidence prose
items.rationale: Separated joined words/numbers without changing hashes, timestamps, versions or disassembly bytes.

items.subject: Security report still said hosted AMD64 evidence was pending
items.rationale: Recorded completed AMD64 build, fixture and security-scan evidence with the exact reviewed commit and Actions run.

items.subject: CodeRabbit docstring coverage below configured threshold
items.rationale: Added documentation to changed Rust functions/tests, Python classes/methods and shell helpers; no execution semantics changed by these comments.

items.subject: Alpine build shell did not propagate pipeline failures
items.rationale: Set the Alpine base SHELL to /bin/ash -eo pipefail -c so derived builder stages inherit pipeline error handling.

items.subject: Consecutive blank lines broke Markdown lint
items.rationale: Already fixed by b677561; current documentation contract passes.

items.subject: Rust 1.99 Clippy rejects empty assertions
items.rationale: Already fixed before this triage; current strict Clippy gate passes.

items.subject: Needless raw string delimiters in YAML test
items.rationale: Already fixed by b8174a4; current YAML test uses an unhashed raw string and strict Clippy passes.

items.subject: Fixture listener exposed every host interface
items.rationale: 29d673d binds loopback on macOS or the Docker bridge gateway on Linux; hosted and local smoke tests pass.

items.subject: Python fixture subprocess calls alleged command injection
items.rationale: Historical code passed argv lists with shell=False and received local test CLI arguments, not incoming HTTP request data. Those subprocess calls were removed in 29d673d; current quoted Bash arrays terminate Docker options before the image. Bandit/Semgrep and hosted Codacy pass.

items.subject: Use Flask jsonify for JSON output
items.rationale: The fixture uses standard-library HTTP handling and JSON-lines/stdout, not Flask. json.dumps correctly escapes strings and the HTTP reply sets application/json and byte Content-Length.

items.subject: Pin all builder apk package versions
items.rationale: This is a reproducibility recommendation, not a reproduced functional/security defect. Existing policy deliberately refreshes maintained Alpine packages; the base is digest-pinned and native archive/provenance and image scans validate the runtime. No lint suppression added.

items.subject: Named Docker USER may not resolve
items.rationale: adduser -D -u 1000 builder precedes USER builder in the same stage. The runtime independently uses numeric USER 65532:65532; builds and nonroot smoke checks pass.

items.subject: LanguageTool Dutch grammar warnings for ff bytes
items.rationale: The flagged ff values are machine-code bytes in retained disassembly evidence. Editing them as prose would corrupt evidence.

items.subject: Rust setup actions duplicate runner capabilities
items.rationale: Pinned setup actions install the selected compiler/targets/components; replacing them with raw rustup is an optional workflow preference, not a reproduced defect.

items.subject: Release matrix values interpolated into scripts
items.rationale: matrix.target and matrix.artifact are literal entries defined in the checked-in release workflow. No attacker-controlled event text or computed matrix supplies these values.

items.subject: CI checkout credentials persisted through artifacts
items.rationale: This job has no artifact upload and caches only Cargo directories and target, not checkout credential storage. It uses pinned checkout v7; no credential artifact path was demonstrated.

items.subject: Trust-store build platform differs from runtime
items.rationale: The stage exports only architecture-independent certificate data and ca-certificates metadata (Architecture: all), valid for both platforms.

items.subject: Copied ca-certificates dpkg status may be invisible to Trivy
items.rationale: Committed final-artifact image_scan.Results includes ca-certificates 20250419+deb13u1 with Arch all; the hosted Trivy scan also passes.

items.subject: Linux fixture lacks host.docker.internal mapping
items.rationale: The wrapper explicitly supplies the Docker bridge gateway mapping on Linux. Hosted Linux DNS/login/clients smoke tests passed.

items.subject: Pinned cosign release might not exist
items.rationale: GitHub release API confirms v3.1.4, published 2026-10-20T18:27:42Z.

items.subject: Accepted positive and no-change automated review observations
items.rationale: Read all additional comments, inline comments, review bodies and issue summaries; positive observations do not request changes. Existing evidence links and exact disassembly bytes remain intact.
